## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track S (safety, trust and handoff behaviour), wave S3. This is audit backlog UX-25 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /nurse/:id at 1024 touch · nurse.
Findings and reviewers: F-28 · reviewers A-18, A-20.
Rationale: BP 168/96, pulse 104 and temperature 39.2 each needed Keep this value: four taps before hand-off, most for the sickest patients; habitual tapping weakens the check. After hand-off a mistyped weight cannot be corrected.
Proposed UX behaviour: When several readings are flagged, one panel lists them in words with their ranges and one confirmation, I re-checked these readings, covers all; each can still be re-measured singly. Until the doctor starts the consultation, the nurse may correct a reading with a reason; the earlier value is kept with who and when, and the doctor sees the corrected value marked corrected. After the doctor starts, readings are fixed as today. The ranges and flags themselves do not change here.
Prototype and blueprint reference: None (the concept did not design nurse intake).
Components and tokens affected: Intake vitals form; Banner for the flagged list. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Front end and back end (the correction with history and its window).
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by a person: the vitals ranges sign-off (issue #956) comes first.
Clinical sign-off: Required before merge: question 16 of the validation plan (clinician and nurse), recorded on the issue with a date.
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: a clinical check is being made lighter; do not ship without the sign-off.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Changing vitals ranges or flags. (2) A vitals form for a nurse when nurse intake is switched off (a product decision recorded on the navigation names ticket). (3) Nurse intake on a phone.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given three flagged readings, when the nurse confirms once, then all three are kept and the record shows each was confirmed
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the flagged list, when the nurse re-measures one, then only that reading changes
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a handed-off intake and a consultation not yet started, when the nurse corrects the weight with a reason, then the new value shows marked corrected and the old one is kept with who and when
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a started consultation, when a correction is sent, then the server refuses it, and the test fails if that rule is removed
- [ ] **AC5.** Given a flagged reading, when it renders, then High or Low and the range are text, not colour alone
- [ ] **AC6.** Given 1024 touch in English and Arabic, when axe runs, then there is no violation and every control is at least 44 px

## Test notes

- Integration: the correction window and history.
- Playwright (tests/e2e/nurse-intake.spec.ts; J3 step 5): enter a high blood pressure and a fever, confirm once; correct a weight before the doctor starts.
